name: mentionlytics-api
description: Query and manage a Mentionlytics account through the Mentionlytics API (v2): mentions, sentiment, top mentioners and keywords, geo/language breakdowns, AI daily summaries, analytics (EMV, MQI), audience demographics, AI Visibility answers and citations, account usage, and creating, updating, pausing and deleting trackers and tracker groups — with token refresh and rate-limit handling built in.
